title: cerasus × chichibuensis var. uyekii
intro: Cerasus × chichibuensis var. uyekii, commonly known as Japanese apricot or Japanese plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cerasus × chichibuensis var. uyekii include anti-tussive, expectorant, and anti-diarrheal effects, which contribute to its traditional use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
